text: For example: “Personal injury” may be defined to include: — “discrimination, racial or religious discrimination and/or violation of civil rights, humiliation, sexual discrimination, alienation of affection, however damages based on the above offenses are only covered where insurance against same is not prohibited by law.” [See Melugin v. Zurich Canada (1996) 50 CA4th 658, 663, 57 CR2d 781, 783] (a) [3:473] “Racial or religious discrimination” not applicable to employment discrimination: The terms “racial or religious discrimination” were held not to cover other forms of discrimination: e.g., employment discrimination (under Title VII of the 1964 Civil Rights Act or under the California FEHA).
